pool_name: Sorted-checkpoint natural-prefix rescue search for Smoke A
purpose: Re-run the one selected dense image under the current immutable validation source, recover every naturally generated prefix from the declared root trajectories, and sample same-prefix alternatives only when native greedy decoding repeats one strictly verified covered owner. This bounded search may provide a transition event for the shared real Smoke A fixture; it does not relax owner verification or admit reconstructed prefixes.

primary_checkpoint.name: Qwen3-VL 2B description-first geometry-sorted pure cross-entropy plus token-type-gate Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation checkpoint at step 4887

owner_review_contract.ontology: Common Objects in Context 80 categories only
owner_review_contract.ledger_semantics: All annotated objects are positive owners; absence of an annotation is never negative evidence.
owner_review_contract.covered_owner_update: one clean complete prefix row with exactly one unambiguous physical owner

primary_case_rule.sampled_only_prefix_claim: conditional own-prefix learnability only; a later training screen must establish fresh end-to-end greedy improvement

images.role: Only image in the previous sorted-checkpoint discovery pool with two naturally generated prefixes whose native greedy continuation was a strictly verified covered duplicate.
images.ledger_priority: official positive labels plus crop review

admission_rule: A Smoke A transition event requires an exact naturally generated prefix from this checkpoint and run, a native greedy verified covered duplicate, and a same-prefix sampled complete row assigned to exactly one verified uncovered physical owner. Terminal, malformed, unsupported, benign-uncovered, ambiguous, and unmatched outcomes remain diagnostics or refusals. Reconstructed, teacher-forced, manually reordered, and cross-checkpoint prefixes are excluded.
